1→# Bivvy CLX (CLI Experience) Design Norms
     2→
     3→Developer-facing guide for building consistent, polished CLI output.
     4→
     5→## Color Assignments
     6→
     7→Colors are **semantic** — each color maps to a specific meaning across the entire CLI.
     8→
     9→| Purpose | Color | Style | Example |
    10→|---------|-------|-------|---------|
    11→| Success / completed | Green | normal | `✓ install_deps (1.2s)` |
    12→| Error / failure | Red | **bold** | `✗ build failed` |
    13→| Warning / caution / blocked | Orange (256: 208) | normal | `⚠ Node version mismatch`, `⊘ blocked` |
    14→| Info / running / hints / progress / divider | Fuchsia/Magenta | normal | Spinners, `Run bivvy status to verify` |
    15→| Secondary / metadata | — | dim | Timestamps, durations, borders |
    16→| Primary emphasis | — | **bold** | Step names in headings, app name |
    17→
    18→The `console` crate supports these via:
    19→- `Style::new().color256(208)` for orange
    20→- `Style::new().magenta()` for fuchsia
    21→- `Style::new().green()`, `.red().bold()`, `.dim()`, `.bold()`
    22→
    23→## Typography Norms
    24→
    25→### Text separation
    26→
    27→Use ` · ` for text separation between distinct elements in things like headers. Never use `:`, `;`, `,`, or `-`.
    28→Color: teal
    29→Text: dim
    30→
    31→- `bivvy · default workflow · 7 steps`
    32→
    33→Use ` | ` to notate optionality in things like configuration options.
    34→
    35→- `--foo | -f`
    36→
    37→Use `: ` to separate labels from values in key-value displays.
    38→
    39→- `Workflow: default`
    40→
    41→### Bold
    42→
    43→Use bold for elements the user's eye should land on first:
    44→
    45→- App name in header: `⛺ **bivvy** · default workflow · 7 steps`
    46→- Step names in step headings: `[2/7] **install_deps** · Install dependencies`
    47→- Key labels in key-value displays: `**Workflow:** default`
    48→- Error icon `✗` is red bold (the only bold icon)
    49→
    50→### Dim
    51→
    52→Use dim for supporting context the user can skip:
    53→
    54→- Descriptions after step names: ` Install dependencies`
    55→- Timestamps and durations: `1.2s`, `2 minutes ago`
    56→- Box-drawing borders: `┌ │ └ ├`
    57→- Progress counters: `[2/7]`
    58→- Commands shown in error blocks
    59→
    60→### Normal (no style)
    61→
    62→Default for body text and values in key-value pairs.
    63→
    64→## Status Vocabulary (`StatusKind`)
    65→
    66→One canonical set of status icons used everywhere:
    67→
    68→| StatusKind | Icon | Color | Non-TTY |
    69→|-----------|------|-------|---------|
    70→| Success | `✓` | green | `[ok]` |
    71→| Failed | `✗` | red bold | `[FAIL]` |
    72→| Skipped | `` | dim | `[skip]` |
    73→| Pending | `◌` | dim | `[pending]` |
    74→| Running | `⠋` | fuchsia | `[run]` |
    75→| Blocked | `⊘` | orange | `[blocked]` |
    76→| Warning | `⚠` | orange | `[warn]` |
    77→
    78→Never invent ad-hoc status symbols. Always use `StatusKind`.
    79→
    80→## Output Modes
    81→
    82→| Mode | Status | Spinners | Live Output | Errors |
    83→|------|--------|----------|-------------|--------|
    84→| Verbose | yes | yes | 3 lines | yes |
    85→| Normal | yes | yes | 2 lines | yes |
    86→| Quiet | no | no | no | yes |
    87→| Silent | no | no | no | no |
    88→
    89→### Which method to use
    90→
    91→- `ui.message(msg)` — General informational text. Hidden in Quiet/Silent.
    92→- `ui.success(msg)` — Operation completed successfully. Hidden in Quiet/Silent.
    93→- `ui.warning(msg)` — Recoverable issue or caution. Hidden in Quiet/Silent.
    94→- `ui.error(msg)` — Something failed. Always shown (except Silent).
    95→- `ui.show_hint(hint)` — Contextual next-step suggestion. Hidden in Quiet/Silent.
    96→
    97→## Spinner Lifecycle
    98→
    99→```
   100→let mut spinner = ui.start_spinner("Running install_deps...");
   101→// optionally update:
   102→spinner.set_message("Installing packages...");
   103→// finish with exactly ONE of:
   104→spinner.finish_success("install_deps (1.2s)");
   105→spinner.finish_error("install_deps failed");
   106→spinner.finish_skipped("install_deps (bundle exec --version)");
   107→```
   108→
   109→Spinners are hidden in Quiet/Silent mode (they create a `ProgressBar::hidden()`).
   110→
   111→## Live Step Output
   112→
   113→During step execution, the last 2-3 lines of command output appear below the spinner (dim, indented). This gives users confidence that work is happening:
   114→
   115→```
   116→    ⠋ Running install_deps...
   117→      yarn install v1.22.19
   118→        Resolving packages...
   119→```
   120→
   121→On finish, the live output lines are cleared and replaced with the final status:
   122→
   123→```
   124→    ✓ install_deps (1.2s)
   125→```
   126→
   127→## Prompts
   128→
   129→All interactive prompts use selectable options with arrow keys + keyboard shortcuts.
   130→Can be configured to support keyboard shortcuts.
   131→Can be configured to be single or multi-select.
   132→No inline `[Y/n]` style prompts.
   133→
   134→```
   135→  Run setup now?
   136→  › Yes (y)
   137→    No  (n)
   138→```
   139→
   140→```
   141→  Run setup now?
   142→  › Yes (y)
   143→    No  (n)
   144→```
   145→
   146→In non-interactive mode, prompts use defaults or skip entirely.
   147→
   148→## Non-Interactive / Non-TTY
   149→
   150→- No spinners (hidden)
   151→- No color (plain theme)
   152→- Status uses bracketed text: `[ok]`, `[FAIL]`, `[skip]`, etc.
   153→- No prompts — uses defaults or skips
   154→- Respects `NO_COLOR` env var
   155→
   156→### CI Output
   157→
   158→When `is_ci()` detects a CI environment (via `CI`, `GITHUB_ACTIONS`, etc.):
   159→
   160→- Non-interactive mode is forced automatically (no need for `--non-interactive`)
   161→- The workflow progress bar is suppressed (noisy in log-based CI output)
   162→- Headers, step output, summaries, and errors are preserved
   163→- Version is shown in the run header: `⛺ bivvy v1.6.1 · ci workflow · 9 steps`
   164→
   165→## Adding New UI Methods
   166→
   167→1. Add the method to the `UserInterface` trait in `src/ui/mod.rs` with a default implementation (so existing impls don't break)
   168→2. Override in `TerminalUI` (`src/ui/terminal.rs`) with the real implementation
   169→3. Override in `NonInteractiveUI` (`src/ui/non_interactive.rs`) for non-TTY behavior
   170→4. Add capture support in `MockUI` (`src/ui/mock.rs`) for testing
   171→
   172→## Box Drawing
   173→
   174→Use for bordered blocks.
   175→Can be configured to optionally omit the title, header, and/or footer.
   176→
   177→```
   178→┌─ Title ──────────────────────────
   179→│ Header content
   180→├──────────────────────────────────
   181→│ Content line 1
   182→│ Content line 2
   183→├──────────────────────────────────
   184→│ Footer content
   185→└──────────────────────────────────
   186→```
   187→
